method_authority.technology_boundary: Treat one kilogram of dry SBR-equivalent polymer. Incineration uses the selected municipal waste-rubber inventory for Europe without Switzerland. Landfill, open burning, and open dumping use the fixed PS/PE treatment components.
method_authority.allocation_boundary: Each native treatment inventory retains its ecoinvent 3.12 cut-off allocation, exchange amounts, uncertainty metadata, and embedded supply chain. Portfolio shares combine the listed treatment inventories additively.
method_authority.geography_year_boundary: The PS, PE, and compatible waste-rubber services are selected separately for each background scenario and provider year. Native ecoinvent supplies these treatment technologies. Matching premise 2020/2025 activities supply the declared premise-only services; the general pre-2030 background remains the specified baseline.
method_authority.limitation: For dry SBR in the tire family, PS represents the styrene-derived 25% and PE represents the butadiene-derived 75%. Others uses a separate grade-1502 principal composition of 23.5/76.5 within compound 22, whose inventory and waste treatment are specified separately.

source_authorities.title: Evaluating the profitability and global warming potential of manufacturing styrene-butadiene rubber with chemicals synthesised from bulk waste plastic and CO2 emissions
source_locations: official supplementary workbook MSE-Ref._Green-SBR Plan A.xlsm

Elastomers (tyres).composition_authority: project inference from the 35/39 carbon fraction in REMIND-MFA 0.2.0 under an SBR-only two-repeat-unit interpretation
Elastomers (tyres).composition_equation: x*(12/13) + (1-x)*(8/9) = 35/39, where 12/13 is the integer-atomic-weight carbon fraction of the styrene repeat C8H8 and 8/9 is that of the butadiene repeat C4H6; the unique solution is x=1/4
Elastomers (tyres).composition_role: Aggregate SBR-equivalent composition derived from the REMIND-MFA carbon fraction.

Others.functional_unit: 1 kg dry E-SBR grade-1502 polymer constituent within the Others portfolio
Others.composition_authority: Dry E-SBR grade-1502 contains 23.5% bound styrene and 76.5% butadiene-derived polymer.
Others.composition_equation: 0.235 kg bound-styrene polymer fraction + 0.765 kg butadiene-derived polymer fraction = 1 kg dry grade-1502 polymer constituent

distinct_composition_decision.decision: retain 0.25/0.75 for Elastomers (tyres) and 0.235/0.765 for the Others E-SBR grade-1502 constituent
distinct_composition_decision.scientific_reason: The tire-family split follows the REMIND-MFA carbon fraction for SBR-equivalent polymer. The Others constituent uses the reported bound-styrene content of commercial grade 1502.
distinct_composition_decision.treatment_limitation: The tire-family composition determines its additive PS/PE treatment weights. The Others composition defines the grade-1502 polymer in compound 22, with auxiliaries and waste treatment represented separately.
